text:
**Score:** 5/10

**Bottom Line:** No, I would not approve this as-is. The code is reasonably organized and the core math is separated well, but the repo is not clean-checkout runnable, packaging is broken for normal installs, generation bootstrap is flawed, and tests could not run in this environment because dependencies were missing.

**Concrete Issues**
| Severity | File | Lines | Issue |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| high | `pyproject.toml` | 24-25 | Package discovery excludes `config.yaml`, so installed CLI defaults can fail outside editable/source installs. |
| high | `emovec/stories.py` | 73-82 | Default extraction requires `data/stories`, but the repo has no story files, so `make demo`/`all --tiny` cannot bootstrap cleanly. |
| high | `emovec/cli.py` | 54-58 | `generate-stories` tries to read an existing manifest before generation, blocking first-time dataset creation. |
| medium | `emovec/stories.py` | 87-90, 138 | Story response parsing treats any preamble before `<NEW STORY>` as a story and can silently save wrong content. |
| medium | `emovec/stories.py` | 122-137 | External story-generation HTTP call has no timeout/retry/error handling and can hang indefinitely. |
| medium | `emovec/model.py` | 73-75, 302-304 | Model wrapper is Gemma/LLaMA-structure-specific despite exposing arbitrary `model_name`. |
| medium | `emovec/extract.py` | 99-110 | Vector loading does not validate manifest/model/shape compatibility before consuming stale output files. |
| medium | `pyproject.toml` | 27-31 | Slow real-model integration tests are skipped by default, leaving no clean-checkout end-to-end regression gate. |
| low | `emovec/vectors.py` | 21-25 | `effective_start(1, ...)` can return an invalid empty averaging span for single-token inputs. |
| low | `emovec/vectors.py` | 66-70 | PCA code divides by total variance without guarding zero-variance inputs. |
| low | `.gitignore` | 1-4 | Generated `outputs/tiny` artifacts are present in the working tree despite being ignored. |
| low | `emovec.egg-info/SOURCES.txt` | 17-22 | Build metadata is checked into the repo and even lists itself as package source. |

**Rewrite Estimate:** About 230 lines need rewrite or significant change: packaging/config inclusion, dataset bootstrap, story-generation robustness, validation around artifacts/configs, model abstraction boundaries, and test/CI cleanup.

Verification: syntax compilation passed when bytecode cache was redirected to `/tmp`; `pytest -q` could not run because required dependencies such as NumPy were not installed in this environment.
